title: ToolCall
description: One record in tool-calls.jsonl inside a NovaFabric Run Capsule. MCP-aligned; transport-agnostic.

parent_span_id.description: OTel span ID that initiated this tool call.

tool_provider.description: URI or short id of the provider (e.g. 'mcp://localhost:8080', 'shell://').

transport.description: Protocol used to invoke the tool.

mutates.description: True if the call modifies state outside the agent's local cache.

mutation_class.description: Classification used by replay safety to determine dry-run default.

arguments.description: Structured arguments passed to the tool. Validated against arguments_schema_ref if present.

arguments_schema_ref.description: Path or URI to JSON Schema for arguments. Null if no schema declared.

result.description: Structured result. Null if tool returned no value or errored.

result_schema_ref.description: Path or URI to JSON Schema for result. Null if no schema declared.

log_level.description: ADR-0127: optional severity of this observation — a stored forensic attribute, never a live signal. Absent is read as 'info' by filters; absence is preserved (never back-filled).

status_message.description: ADR-0127: optional one-line human-readable reason for the level. Secret-scanned and redacted at capture (ADR-0009); an annotation, not a log stream.

log_level_source.description: ADR-0127: provenance of log_level; on disagreement the most severe source wins at capture and is recorded here.

agent_call_id.description: model_call_id in model-calls.jsonl that triggered this tool. Null if not model-driven.

mcp.description: MCP-specific fields. Required when transport is 'mcp'.

pre_state.description: Snapshot of relevant state before the call.

post_state.description: Snapshot of relevant state after the call.

error.description: Error detail when status is not 'success'.

retries.description: Number of retries the SDK performed before this record was finalized.

cache_hit.description: True if the SDK or proxy served the response from cache.

cost.description: Metered cost of this tool call, if applicable.

latency_ms.description: Network or process latency excluding agent-side handling.

bytes_in.description: Approximate size of arguments in bytes.

bytes_out.description: Approximate size of result in bytes.

endpoint.description: Concrete URL or endpoint hit, sanitized of secrets per secret-policy-v0.

replay_hint.description: Per-call replay guidance written by the framework adapter at capture time.

schema_validation.description: Optional recorded verdict of validating arguments/result against the declared *_schema_ref JSON Schemas (ADR-0128). Additive; absence means 'not validated' and is never a failure.

extensions.description: Vendor extensions. Keys must be reverse-DNS-prefixed (e.g. 'io.langgraph.thread_id').

arguments_valid.description: True/false if arguments were checked against arguments_schema_ref; null if no arguments schema was declared.

result_valid.description: True/false if result was checked against result_schema_ref; null if no result schema was declared or the tool errored.

errors.description: Structured failures. Empty when everything checked was valid. Bounded (capped with a synthetic 'truncated' entry).

checked_at.description: When validation ran (capture time, or backfill time for --write).

arguments_schema_ref.description: Echo of the arguments_schema_ref actually resolved.

result_schema_ref.description: Echo of the result_schema_ref actually resolved.

SchemaValidationVerdict.description: ADR-0128 verdict block: records whether the declared *_schema_ref contract was met. null means 'no schema declared' — not a failure.

target.description: Which payload the error applies to.

path.description: JSON Pointer / path to the offending value, e.g. '$.items[0].price'.

keyword.description: The JSON Schema keyword that failed (type, required, ...), or 'schema-unresolved' / 'truncated'.

server_name.description: MCP server name per MCP spec Server Info.

kind.description: What was captured in this snapshot.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 hash of the declared state surface. Present for state-fingerprint kind.

declared_scope.description: Paths or identifiers describing what state surface was captured.

type.description: Exception class name or error kind.

message.description: Human-readable error description, sanitized for secrets.

traceback_ref.description: Relative path under outputs/ where the traceback is stored.

preferred_mode.description: Suggested replay mode for this call.

allow_in_exact.description: Whether this tool call may be re-executed in exact mode.

allow_in_semantic.description: Whether this tool call may be re-executed in semantic mode.

max_age_for_reference.description: ISO 8601 duration; maximum age of reference resources for replay.
